purpose: Define deterministic projections over the canonical Topic graph so a consumer can request a subject, mechanism or broad area and receive its direct, inherited and composed trace surface without changing canonical semantics.

semantics.identity_rule: This member gives an exact owner-scoped identity to the literal Flow token without adding semantics beyond the owning Flow reference field and the preserved source literal.
semantics.interpretation_rule: Consumers may use this identity as an opaque declared Flow symbol. No meaning may be inferred from spelling, whitespace, filename, path or similarity to another symbol.
semantics.authority_rule: A Flow symbol is descriptive/causal model data only and never grants runtime authority, capability, ownership or execution permission.
semantics.scope_rule: Identity is scoped semantically to the defining contract; identical source literals in another contract or another Flow-ref role are not automatically the same semantic identity.

topics.name: Topic Projection
topics.purpose: Group deterministic read-only projections over Topic inheritance, composition, membership and Outsider status.

operations.name: Project direct Topic surface
outputs: direct members and direct trace refs

operations.name: Project inherited Topic context
outputs: ancestor Topics and inherited grouping context

operations.name: Project composed Topic surface
outputs: resolved component Topics and reusable trace surfaces

operations.name: Project complete Topic view
outputs: direct + inherited + composed Topic trace surface

operations.name: Project Outsiders
outputs: visible unresolved Topic classifications with reasons

projection_modes.direct: Only the Topic's explicit local member and trace references.
projection_modes.inherited: Direct surface plus recursively resolved ancestor Topic grouping context.
projection_modes.composed: Direct surface plus recursively resolved composed Topic trace surfaces.
projection_modes.complete: Direct + inherited + composed surfaces, preserving provenance for every included item.
projection_modes.outsiders: Active canonical identities with no direct or inherited Topic membership, including explicit outsider_reason.

provenance.rule: Every projected item must retain how it entered the projection so a consumer can distinguish direct definition from inherited grouping and composed reuse.

semantics.projection_rule: Projection is read-only. It may flatten a Topic graph for presentation, analysis or Structure Projector use, but the flattened view is never canonical authority.
semantics.mechanism_view: A composed mechanism Topic can be projected as one end-to-end view while every reused semantic element retains its original canonical identity and provenance.

invariants.rule: Topic projection cannot mutate canonical definitions.
Projection preserves original canonical identities and provenance.

hard_gates.condition: Projection creates a new semantic definition by flattening or copying projected content.
Projection order is interpreted as execution causality.
A projected item loses whether it was direct, inherited or composed.
Outsider identities are omitted from a requested Outsider projection.

references.purpose: Projection resolves Topic semantics defined by the Topic Mechanism contract.
Projection participates in the recursive Core Topic tree.

prose.summary: Defines read-only deterministic Topic projections for direct, inherited, composed, complete and Outsider views while preserving identity and provenance.
notes: This provides the generic read surface needed by Structure Projector and other consumers without making projection output canonical authority.
Pass 8 formalized previously free Flow actor/data/target/condition/payload/result/error tokens as exact owner-scoped member identities while preserving every source literal.
